claim.claim-text: 2. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the charging system further comprises a third protection circuit, and the third protection circuit is electrically connected to the second end of the second switch and is configured to control the first voltage to be below a third preset voltage value when the first voltage is greater than the third preset voltage value, and a duration of the first voltage being greater than the third preset voltage value reaches a second preset time.
3. The charging system according to claim 2, wherein the third protection circuit comprises a zener diode.

4. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the control circuit comprises a first control circuit and a second control circuit, the first control circuit is electrically connected to the first voltage acquisition circuit, the second control circuit is electrically connected to the first control circuit and a control terminal of the first switch respectively, the first control circuit generates a first control signal based on the first voltage, and the second control circuit cyclically controls the switch on/off time of the first switch based on the first control signal.
5. The charging system according to claim 4, wherein the second control circuit is a driver circuit consisted of discrete totem-pole circuit or a chip integrated circuit.
6. The charging system according to claim 4, wherein the second control circuit outputs a first Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) control signal to the first switch.

7. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the charging system further comprises a temperature sensor, and the temperature sensor is arranged within a preset distance range of the first switch and/or the inductor.

8. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the charging system further comprises a third switch and a fourth switch, a first end of the third switch is electrically connected to the charging input interface, a second end of the third switch is electrically connected to a first end of the inductor and a first end of the fourth switch respectively, a second end of the fourth switch is electrically connected to the ground terminal, and a control terminal of the third switch is electrically connected to the control circuit; and the control circuit is configured to cyclically control a switch on/off time of the third switch based on the first voltage; and during the charging process of the charging system, when the first voltage is less than the first preset voltage value, the third switch is in a switch-on state, and the fourth switch is in a switch-off state; when the first voltage is greater than the first preset voltage value, the first switch is in a switch-off state, and the control circuit controls the third switch to cutoff and starts the cyclic control; when the third switch is in a switch-on state, the fourth switch is in a switch-off state; and when the third switch is in a switch-off state, the fourth switch is in a switch-on state.

9. The charging system according to claim 8, wherein the third switch is a Metal Oxide Semiconductor (MOS) transistor, the fourth switch is a diode, the first end of the fourth switch is a cathode of the diode, and the second end of the fourth switch is an anode of the diode.
10. The charging system according to claim 8, wherein the control circuit outputs a second PWM control signal to the third switch.

11. The charging system according to claim 8, wherein when the first voltage is greater than the first preset voltage value, and a duration of the first voltage being greater than the first preset voltage value reaches the first preset time, the control circuit controls the third switch to cutoff and starts the cyclic control.

12. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the first switch is a MOS transistor, the second switch is a diode, the first end of the second switch is an anode of the diode, and the second end of the second switch is a cathode of the diode.
13. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the control circuit outputs a first PWM control signal to the first switch.
14. The charging system according to claim 13, wherein the first PWM control signal controls an increase of the switch on time of the first switch within one cycle.

15. The charging system according to claim 14, wherein when the first voltage is greater than the first preset voltage value, the first PWM control signal controls a reduction of the switch on time of the first switch within one cycle.

16. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the first switch is a MOS transistor, the second switch is a MOS transistor, and a control terminal of the second switch is connected to the control circuit.

17. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the charging system further comprises a first capacitor, one end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to the second end of the second switch, and the other end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to the ground terminal.
18. The charging system according to claim 1, wherein the charging input interface is a universal serial bus connector.

19. The charging system according to claim 18, wherein the charging input interface comprises a first pin, a second pin, and a third pin; the first pin is a positive terminal, the second pin is a negative terminal, and the third pin is a signal terminal; and the third pin is configured to communicate with an external charger.

20. The charging system according to claim 19, wherein the charging system comprises a first resistor, one end of the first resistor is electrically connected to the third pin, and the other end of the first resistor is electrically connected to the second pin.
